title: Koszul interchange before tensor evaluation
statement: Let Y be a scheme in universe t and R a commutative ring sheaf in universe max(u,t+1) on its pro-etale site. For arbitrary complexes H,P,I,Q and a chain map e from H tensor P to I, there is a chain map psi from (H tensor Q) tensor P to I tensor Q. On local homogeneous tensor generators v,z,x in degrees a,b,p, its value is (-1)^(bp) times e(v tensor x) tensor z, with the indicated canonical total-degree transports. Tensor products and generators are the actual complexes of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] and [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. No boundedness, flatness or injectivity is assumed.

proof.text: Form psi by the associator, identity tensor the braiding Q tensor P to P tensor Q, the inverse associator, and e tensor identity. On pure generators use the associator and tensor-map formulas, then the braiding formula. Its sign is (-1)^(bp). Integer linearity carries the sign through the remaining maps, and the inverse associator and evaluation tensor identity give the claimed expression. Local caches of the existing structures keep elaboration from repeatedly unfolding their constructions.

theorem tensorEvaluation_interchange
    (H P I Q : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ)
    (e : (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj H).obj P) ⟶ I) :
    ∃ psi : (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
        (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj H).obj Q)).obj P) ⟶
        (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I).obj Q),
      ∀ (a b p : ℤ) (U : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt Y)ᵒᵖ)
        (v : (H.X a).val.obj U) (z : (Q.X b).val.obj U) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U),
        (psi.f (p + (a + b))).val.app U
            (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} J R
              (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj H).obj Q) P
              (a + b) p (p + (a + b)) (add_comm (a + b) p) U
              (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} J R H Q a b (a + b) rfl U v z) x) =
          (b * p).negOnePow •
            coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} J R I Q (p + a) b (p + (a + b))
              (add_assoc p a b) U
              ((e.f (p + a)).val.app U
                (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} J R H P a p (p + a)
                  (add_comm a p) U v x)) z
